notes.title: Big Demo Update! v0.1.2 is Live 🎯
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a major update to the Greedy Darts demo — v0.1.2 is now live!

Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] 🧭 Revamped UI for a cleaner, more intuitive experience
[*] 🃏 The total number of cards has increased to 63, opening up more strategy options
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206218/56873d92d71c15c2e2d1aa5aac8018eaf49e5711.png[/img]
[*] 📘 Tutorial added — learn the basics quickly and jump right in
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206218/0ee6a6f370ab230fcd38ea12f8eafc8fca7fb71b.png[/img]
[*] 🎯 A new game mode: Count Up Only has been added for focused play[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206218/61f8d459a62ea8fdb7a168b87b02be6dc10dfbf3.png[/img]
[*] ✨ Tons of smaller updates including UI tweaks, new effects, and visual polish
[/list]
This is one of the biggest updates yet, and we’d love to hear what you think!

Please share your feedback with us on [Discord] or in the Steam Community — it really helps shape the game as we move toward Early Access.

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/s6aDrYK9T4]Join our Discord[/url]

Thanks for playing, and enjoy the new demo!

— tamtam

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all, [b]thank you so much[/b] to everyone who played the demo and added [i]Greedy Darts[/i] to your wishlist 🎯 Your support means the world to us!

We’re happy to report that [b]development is going smoothly[/b] — no major issues so far, and we’re making steady progress every week 💪

If you’re interested in more frequent updates, we post [b]development progress regularly on Discord[/b]. Feel free to stop by and see what’s going on!

We’re also planning to release [b]a new and improved demo[/b] before the Early Access launch. This update will include:
[list]
[*] 💡 Reworked and optimized UI
[*] 📚 A new tutorial to help players get started
[*] 🃏 More cards and combos
[*] 🎯 A new game mode: _Just Count Up_ (focused darts scoring)
[/list]
    
We’re putting a lot into it, and we hope it gives you a better feel for what [i]Greedy Darts[/i] is all about.

🗺️ We’ve also shared our [b]development roadmap on Discord[/b], so if you’d like to see what’s coming next, join us!

And of course, we’d [b]love to hear your feedback or ideas[/b] — either in the Steam Community discussions or on our Discord.

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/s6aDrYK9T4]Discord Community[/url]

Thanks again, and talk soon!

tamtam
